interpretation: Independent fresh seed and cohort. Excludes the published prior corpus and available Gen5 training families. Common Gen6 auctions and native partnership auctions are paired on each board, with swapped rooms; identical full auctions reuse physical games. Play=common IMPs; total=native IMPs; bidding=total-play (includes auction/play interaction). Exploratory paired intervals are unadjusted for repeated monitoring. Early cohort archived and excluded from dashboard; only its unplayed families continue here.
model_note: Gen6 fast: 32 layouts until trick7; medium: 256 until trick6. Lead belief net only on opening lead, then hand-fit scorer; late compatible-layout list solves up to 256. Policy breaks exact ties. Gen5 is the frozen 5RZ32 actor; BEN uses 16 samples. Corrected BEN matchup: Gen6 medium (256) vs BEN (16), 15%; all other matchups unchanged. After positive significance trigger, BEN16/medium receives no new boards; BEN32/medium and BEN16/fast each receive 7.5%. BEN32 uses a separately configured service.

difference_definition.unit: IMPs per board, candidate minus opponent
difference_definition.bidding: Native minus common on the same board; includes auction/play interaction
difference_definition.uncertainty: Student-t intervals on paired per-board differences; exploratory, unadjusted for repeated monitoring
